dimensions.name: age_band
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN age < 18 THEN '00-17'
  WHEN age < 30 THEN '18-29'
  WHEN age < 45 THEN '30-44'
  WHEN age < 60 THEN '45-59'
  WHEN age < 75 THEN '60-74'
  ELSE '75+'
END

dimensions.name: recency_bucket
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN datediff(current_date(), last_test_date) <= 90 THEN '1. 0-90 days'
  WHEN datediff(current_date(), last_test_date) <= 180 THEN '2. 91-180 days'
  WHEN datediff(current_date(), last_test_date) <= 365 THEN '3. 181-365 days'
  ELSE '4. 365+ days'
END
dimensions.comment: Days since last test relative to today

dimensions.name: day_name
dimensions.comment: Prefixed with day number (1=Sun) for chronological sorting

dimensions.name: day_type
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_weekend THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END
